description: This file defines a PhotosHandler class and related data structures for handling photo retrieval requests in an Android app. It includes interface for photo data sources, permissions handling, querying media store, decoding and encoding images, and generating JSON responses.

classes.name: PhotosLatestRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for latest photos with parameters limit, maxWidth, and quality.

classes.name: EncodedPhotoPayload
classes.description: Data class representing an encoded photo with format, base64 string, dimensions, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: PhotosDataSource
classes.description: Interface for photo data source, defines methods for permission check and fetching latest photos.

classes.name: SystemPhotosDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of PhotosDataSource interfacing with Android's MediaStore to fetch photos, decode, and encode images appropriately.

classes.name: PhotosHandler
classes.description: Main class managing photo requests and responses, including permission checks, request parsing, and JSON response building.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest
methods.description: Handles the photo request, checks permissions, parses JSON parameters, fetches photos, and creates JSON response.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string parameters into PhotosLatestRequest object with default value handling.
